description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_String, which represents an XML-RPC string value as part of the Zend Framework's XML-RPC implementation. It extends Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar and provides methods to set and retrieve its value, ensuring proper encoding and type safety.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_String
classes.description: A class representing an XML-RPC string value, extending Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar, providing functionality to set and get the string value.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a string value, setting the correct XML-RPC type.
